name: ryzhy_bench_a
prompt: Game sprite sheet: 8 animation frames of ONE smooth bench-press push from the lowest point up to the top, in a grid of 2 rows x 4 columns, read left to right, top row first, generous empty space between frames, never mirror a frame. Character: the orange tabby tomcat Ryzhy (big, muscular, chubby), EXACTLY as in the FIRST reference (colours, body proportions, line weight). Pose and camera angle as in the SECOND reference: lying on his back on an invisible bench, head on the right, legs bent and down to the floor. DRAW NO BARBELL AT ALL: both front paws are clenched fists gripping an invisible horizontal bar, a normal grip, the fists about shoulder width apart, the two fists always at the same height as each other. The arms keep their natural length in every frame (never stretch the arms). VERY IMPORTANT: the head, body, belly, legs, feet and tail stay EXACTLY in the same place, size and angle in all 8 frames, only the arms move. The SAME facial expression in all 8 frames (calm confident smirk exactly as in the SECOND reference: the same eyes, brows and mouth, no blinking, no grimace, no change of expression), the arms never cover the face. Comic book style exactly like the references. IMPORTANT: no bench, no floor line. IMPORTANT: the background of the whole sheet MUST be solid flat pure chroma-key GREEN (#00FF00) everywhere, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no frame numbers. Do not use green on the character.
